mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.address, a.start_date, a.end_date, a.description, a.headcount, a.headcount_limit, a.status, u.username AS poster_name FROM activity a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.poster_id = u.id ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.address, a.start_date, a.end_date, a.description, a.headcount, a.headcount_limit, a.status, u.username AS poster_name FROM activity a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.poster_id = u.id WHERE a.poster_id = #{posterId} ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.address, a.start_date, a.end_date, a.description, a.headcount, a.headcount_limit, a.status, u.username AS poster_name FROM activity a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.poster_id = u.id WHERE a.status=1 ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.address, a.start_date, a.end_date, a.description, a.headcount, a.headcount_limit, a.status, u.username AS poster_name FROM registration r JOIN activity a on r.activity_id=a.id JOIN users u ON a.poster_id =u.id WHERE r.registrant_id=#{MyId} ORDER BY a.start_date ASC
